subject: Re: Kickoff: bi-tempered loss - status + a tuning risk
body:
Status: M1 done. Our implementation matches the open-source release including the bias-correction term; unit tests confirm we recover generalized cross entropy for 0 <= t1 <= 1 with t2 = 1, and t-logistic behavior at t1 = 1, t2 >= 1.

Benchmarks: at 20% symmetric label noise, bi-tempered (t1=0.7, t2=1.3) beats cross entropy by +2.1 points test accuracy on our internal suite. At 40% noise the gap widens to +4.8.

Risk: temperature sensitivity. Outside roughly t1 in [0.6, 0.9] the gains evaporate, and one customer-like config diverged at t2=2.0. Shipping a "default" needs either an auto-tuning heuristic or a very conservative preset, and Rafael's take is the heuristic is 3+ weeks of work.

Reminder that we are three weeks from the June 26 Corpus freeze - Gustavo's last two ingestion tickets are still queued with the Corpus team.

Yara
